name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv-lags
notes: Controlled twin of run-hstar-cv-postcovid.json with raw lags added. Identical in every respect except features.lookback, which moves from 0 to 30, emitting ret_lag_0..ret_lag_29 — one-minute tape lags — alongside the 66 session and momentum columns, for 96 features. ADR-0058 explicitly excluded raw lags on the argument that the momentum and realized-vol scales already condense the recent path; this run tests that argument rather than assuming it. Same 20 folds, same two names, same bounded 730-day window, same estimator and seed, so the paired difference is attributable to the lag columns alone.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label. One tree, five H's. Short HPO lives on the scan node, not universe.scan.

alpaca.notes: Historical SIP tape. root is the invoking cwd; run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale already in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session.

features.notes: As the post-COVID run, plus 30 raw one-minute lags (ret_lag_0..29). ret_lag_0 was already computed internally for the SPY residual; this exposes it and its predecessors as model inputs. 96 features total.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals. One tree; each name still walks its own H.

pair.notes: Two names only. Rows are per-symbol frames, so this drops whole frames the way keep-symbols does. Sits after tradable so the cohort that built the features is untouched.

scan.notes: One LightGBM over the two kept names; last column is the symbol category. train_start_ms is the walk-forward left bound (ADR-0050): without it train_days is inert. No min_split_gain, which at a 5-minute label variance near 2.6e-06 made every tree a stump. The node refuses a fold whose forecast is constant, and logs the fitted window so an inert bound cannot be silent again.

walkforward.notes: Same 20 folds as the post-COVID run so the two pair fold for fold. Post-COVID only, real 730-day training window. The AAPL 2020-08-31 split still lands in folds 1-2 training.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
